label: end-of-episode (low value) unit at GO and S1-reached D2
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (ep_trial 90-99 holds 98% of activation mass; never before trial 80). The model value output tracks this: value < 5.22 covers 99.9% of mass, and it never fires at higher value. Within that window it fires at GO (77% of mass) and at D2 when the reached state is S1 (D2 showing S2 is weak), almost never at D1 (except reward-penalty / fixation-break steps). Stronger at GO when the agent is about to choose a2 (very negative choice logit), and the biggest activations are a2 choices in S2-good blocks. Recorded predicate uses only observed quantities (the model value, phase, the state shown at D2). Dev F1 0.77, mass recall 0.94. Alternative (ep_trial >= 90) & (phase != D1) gives mass recall 0.97 at precision 0.43. Lower value gives larger activation: value < 3 has precision 0.91. Not explained: which late-episode GO/D2 steps stay below threshold, which depends partly on magnitude (value) and the upcoming a2 choice.
